anchors.statement: The storage contract MUST provide one generic operation that runs several row operations as a single atomic unit, implemented by each engine (SQLite, Postgres, MySQL).

anchors.statement: If the SQLite writer thread panics, every caller waiting on it MUST receive an error rather than waiting indefinitely.
anchors.quote: a panic on the writer thread reaches every waiting caller as an error, never a hang
anchors.context: storage contract direction: atomic transactions, cron feature withdrawn
anchors.summary: writer panic reaches waiting callers as error
anchors.scope: plan items that implement or change the SQLite writer thread, its request channel or its reply path
anchors.deterministic_check: deterministic test: a request that panics on the writer thread makes every pending caller receive an error; no await hangs (no sleeps)

pass: The writer thread runs each request under catch_unwind; on panic it fails the request and drains the channel, so every queued caller receives StorageError::WriterPanicked.
fail: If a request panics, the writer thread exits and queued callers' oneshot replies are never sent, so their awaits never complete.
